text: Q. This meme originates from a character named Raul, played by actor Fred Armisen. What made the clip so irresistible to the internet was the character's complete and utter deadpan conviction — no irony, no hesitation, no proportionality — transforming what should be a comic cameo into an infinitely reusable template for anyone wishing to express zero tolerance for any behaviour whatsoever. ID the meme.
